Subject: Question on connector bundle and stepdown exceptions

Hi Priya,

We're evaluating a move from Compact to Throughput for our production cluster, but we're worried about losing the connector bundle that powers several external integrations (Zendesk, Segment). Two quick questions:

- If we step down tiers later, is there any way to keep connectors for a grace period?
- How does proration work for add-ons and core tier changes? We're mid-quarter and need to understand billing impact.

We're close to committing but need confidence on feature continuity and a negotiated path if usage spikes unexpectedly. Can we schedule a short call this week? Happy to share usage numbers in advance.

Thanks,
Adam Cole
Head of Platform, Acuma Health
adam@acumahealth.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Adam Cole <adam@acumahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on connector bundle and stepdown exceptions

Hi Adam —

Thanks for the clear framing. Short answers up front, details below:

- Grace period: Yes — we can preserve connector entitlements for a configurable grace window (default 60 days) during a tier stepdown. That can be extended to 90 days by exception for customers with active integrations.
- Proration: Tier changes are prorated based on remaining days in the billing period for the core tier. Add-ons (like the connector bundle) are prorated separately; if you add an add-on mid-period you'll be billed pro rata for the remainder of that period.

Options I recommend:
1) Temporary connector add-on on Throughput for 90 days, then evaluate. Keeps integrations intact while you migrate traffic.
2) Apply a migration credit to offset the first 30 days of add-on cost if you convert to a 12-month commitment today.

I've attached a short pack_comparison_v1.pdf that shows feature parity and the add-on math across Compact vs Throughput.

If this looks good, let's do a 30-minute workshop (technical + billing) tomorrow or Thursday. I can invite our solution engineer and Ben can walk commercial terms.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Question on connector bundle and stepdown exceptions — proposed commercial

Adam / team —

Following Priya's note, here's what we can offer commercially to de-risk the migration:

- 15% onboarding discount on the first 12 months of Throughput commit (applies to core tier only).
- One-time migration credit equal to the prorated cost of the connector add-on for the remainder of your current quarter (applies if you sign a 12-month term).
- Contract language: we will add a 90-day connector carveout in Section 3.2 that preserves connector entitlements during one tier stepdown; this will be visible in the amendment draft.

I'm attaching a draft amendment (amendment_draft.docx) with suggested wording. If legal wants a different cadence for the carveout we can iterate — but the intent is to make the customer safe for the migration window.

If you want me to lock numbers in I can prep a formal quote (deal id ACM-2026-0432) after the workshop.

—Ben
